scope_boundaries: Compact connected Riemann surface and smooth positive backgrounds; ordinary models normalized by supremum zero, including zero non-pluripolar mass.
Area rescaling gives compatible homotheties and commutes with ideal projection; dividing distance by area gives isometries.
Unscaled model spaces are isometric exactly when their areas agree; fixed polar data give an isometry on the common admissible range and preserve ordinary type.
The smooth gauge controls representatives uniformly over the whole model space. Uniform convergence to a smooth positive background gives uniform L1 and capacity convergence under transport.
Analytic models are preserved by rational area ratios; irrational scaling of a nonzero rational atom need not preserve the book's rational analytic class. Ideal models are always preserved.
Arbitrary nonpositive smooth backgrounds, zero-area degeneration and higher-dimensional zero-volume background continuity are outside this unit.
